home.processStep1Body: We visit the property, listen to your plans and give you a realistic price range, with the reasoning behind it.
home.processStep2Body: We put the paperwork in order, advise on what is worth refreshing and take professional photographs.
home.processStep3Body: A listing in four languages, a 360° tour or a 3D walkthrough, and advertising targeted at buyers in Serbia and the diaspora.
home.processStep4Body: We conduct every viewing, screen buyers for serious interest and negotiate on your behalf.
home.processStep5Body: We prepare the contract with a lawyer and oversee the notarisation, the tax filing and the handover of the keys.

home.servicesRelocationBody: Buying from abroad, with no need to travel. Live viewings by video call, and power of attorney arranged through our lawyer.
home.servicesRentBody: Reliable tenants and sound tenancy agreements. We vet every applicant and manage the handover.
home.servicesSellBody: The right price, the right buyers, without the stress. We prepare the property, photograph it and see negotiations through to signing.
home.servicesToursBody: Open to everyone, around the clock. 360° tours and 3D walkthroughs of selected properties.

free.a: The online valuation is free and takes about two minutes. A valuation in person is free as well, with no obligation to instruct us: we come at a time that suits you and leave you the range in writing.

accuracy.a: For a standard flat in an area with plenty of price data, the range sits close to the market. For unusual properties — attic conversions, adapted spaces, unregistered extensions, houses on large plots — the margin widens, so the figure should be checked on site. That is why the result is always an interval rather than a single number.

data.a: We use the details from the form only to calculate the range and to reply to you. We do not sell them or pass them to third parties. You receive our selection of new properties only if you tick that box, and you may request deletion at any time at the address given in our privacy policy.

sell.heading: Sell with us
sell.lede: We prepare, photograph and present your property to the right buyers, and you always know where matters stand.
sell.metaDescription: Selling an apartment, house or commercial property in Belgrade or elsewhere in Serbia: a visit and price proposal, a documents check, professional photography and guidance through to handover.
sell.mediaAlt: Entrance hall with double doors and keys on a stone console
sell.benefitsLede: A sale without improvisation: verified paperwork, a well-prepared property and a price grounded in data.

benefits.b1: A price proposal after a visit, compared with completed sales in your area.
benefits.b2: A documents check before the listing goes live, with a list of anything that needs resolving.
benefits.b3: Professional photography, plus a floor plan and a 360° tour for selected properties.
benefits.b4: A listing in Serbian, English, Russian and German.
benefits.b5: Viewings by appointment, and a written report on buyers' reactions.
benefits.b6: Coordination with a solicitor and a notary through to the handover of the keys.

sell.valuationPrompt: Would you like an indicative range first? The online valuation is based on average prices in your area and takes two minutes.
sell.processLede: Five steps from the first visit to handing over the keys. After each one you know what comes next and what we need from you.

s1.title: Introduction and valuation
s1.body: We visit the property, review the paperwork and give you a written price proposal and a sales plan.

s2.title: Preparation and photography
s2.body: We suggest small fixes before the shoot, then the photographer comes in; for selected properties we also produce a floor plan and a 360° tour.

s3.title: Marketing and the 3D tour
s3.body: We write the listing in four languages and publish it on our site, on the portals and to our buyer database.

s4.title: Viewings and negotiation
s4.body: We host viewings by appointment, send you a note after each one and negotiate offers in writing. The decision is always yours.

s5.title: Contract and handover
s5.body: We prepare the contract with a solicitor, coordinate notarisation and payment, and attend the handover.

sell.documentsLede: A sale usually requires the following. The exact list depends on the property and how it was acquired, so we go through it together at our first meeting.

d1.title: Title deed extract (list nepokretnosti)
d1.note: The cadastre extract showing the ownership and registration of the property.

d2.title: Basis of acquisition
d2.note: A purchase contract, an inheritance ruling, a deed of gift or another legal basis.

d3.title: Owners' identity documents
d3.note: An ID card or passport for each owner; a certified power of attorney if someone represents you.

d4.title: Occupancy permit or legalisation decision
d4.note: Where applicable — most often for newer buildings, extensions and legalised properties.

d5.title: Proof of settled bills
d5.note: Recent bills for Infostan, electricity and heating; where needed, confirmation that property tax has been paid.

d6.title: Spouse's consent
d6.note: Usually required if the property was acquired during marriage, even when it is registered to one spouse only.

d7.title: Energy performance certificate
d7.note: If one exists — usually the case for newer buildings.

sell.documentsNote: This list is for guidance and is not legal advice. If anything is missing, we will tell you what is needed and where to obtain it.

q1.a: Commission is agreed in the brokerage agreement and depends on the type of transaction and the scope of the service. The current tariff forms part of our terms of business.

q2.q: Are the visit and the price proposal free?
q2.a: Yes. The visit and the price proposal do not commit you to working with us.

q3.q: How long does a sale take?
q3.a: It depends on the price, the location and the paperwork. You receive an estimated timeframe in the written proposal after our visit.
